text: Editorâ€™s Foreword The Lesbian Liberation Movement and the Gay Liberation Movement are among the most recent movements in this series, and also the most vigorous.
text_raw:
Editorâ€™s Foreword
The Lesbian Liberation Movement and the Gay Liberation Movement are among the most
recent movements in this series, and also the most vigorous.

text: They are still evolving rapidly, and it is sometimes hard to keep up with the changes, which explains why this volume is a particularly important one.
text_raw:
They are still evolving rapidly,
and it is sometimes hard to keep up with the changes, which explains why this volume is a
particularly important one.

text: It deals with events that are happening all around us, that affect more and more of us, and have an impact that is gradually spreading from the United States and Europe, where they originated, to Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

text: Moreover, while the individuals concerned can be summed up under one heading or anotherâ€”lesbian, gay, queer, bisexual, transgendered, and so forthâ€”and their organizations have formal names and goals, the realities are far more varied and much harder to summarize, let alone define.

text: A lawyer, activist, and writer, Vaid is former executive director of both the National Gay and Lesbian Task Force and its Policy Institute, as well as a deputy director at Arcas Institute and the Ford Foundation.
text_raw:
A lawyer, activist, and writer, Vaid is former executive director of
both the National Gay and Lesbian Task Force and its Policy Institute, as well as a deputy
